about: What changed on nfs2se.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. nfs3-webgl's tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: new
Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: linked in the menu and in the early-version note.
new
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
new
Lap Records on the start page: every racer's best lap on each track, in both directions. Laps driven with mods on don't count.
new
Instant steering (Game Settings): the wheels turn to full lock at once, like with a joystick back in the day.
new
Phones and tablets: on-screen buttons to steer, brake and accelerate; a finger on the picture works as the mouse.
new
iPhone: the game files now save on iOS 18, and the page shows how to get fullscreen with Add to Home Screen.
new
Bonus cars (Bomber BFS, Tombstone, FZR 2000) and the Monolithic Studios track unlocked (Game Settings, on by default).
fixed
The picture was too dark, night tracks nearly black: the game's own brightness setting and fog are now used.
fixed
Cars driving into a shadow lost their textures in black speckles.
improved
On 60, 120 and 240 Hz screens every frame is shown once: no more small hitches.
improved
Sharpness starts at Auto; the Resolutions option, which did nothing in this game, is gone.
fixed
Long sessions no longer run out of memory.
new
First version: Need for Speed II: Special Edition (the 3dfx version) recompiled to WebAssembly. The game files download automatically, once.
new
A start page in the style of the game's menus.
new
Online races: lobby, rooms and invite links; the game's network screens draw correctly, and your car reacts at once even when someone else hosts.
new
Your lobby name is your name in the game (up to 8 characters).
fixed
Cars flashed other cars' colours; each car now keeps its own.
